description: This file contains utility functions for parsing, classifying, and building test plans for a testing framework based on Vitest. It imports various Node.js modules and specific path helper functions, and defines functions to interpret command-line arguments and configuration files for running project tests.

methods.name: normalizePathPattern
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a string, standardizing path patterns.

methods.name: isExistingPathTarget
methods.description: Checks if the given path exists within the current working directory.

methods.name: isExistingFileTarget
methods.description: Checks if the specified path points to an existing file.

methods.name: isGlobTarget
methods.description: Determines if the string contains glob pattern characters.

methods.name: isFileLikeTarget
methods.description: Identifies if the argument resembles a test file pattern based on extension.

methods.name: isPathLikeTargetArg
methods.description: Determines if an argument is a valid path-like pattern for test files or directories.

methods.name: toRepoRelativeTarget
methods.description: Converts an argument into a path relative to the repository root.

methods.name: toScopedIncludePattern
methods.description: Creates an include pattern for test files based on the argument, ensuring proper glob patterns.

methods.name: classifyTarget
methods.description: Classifies a target argument into categories such as 'extension', 'channel', 'boundary', etc., based on its path and file type.

methods.name: createVitestArgs
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for running Vitest based on provided parameters.

methods.name: parseTestProjectsArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to identify forwarded arguments, target test files, and modes like watch mode.

methods.name: buildVitestRunPlans
methods.description: Builds a sequence of test run plans based on the parsed arguments, grouping targets by type and associating configs.

methods.name: createVitestRunSpecs
methods.description: Creates test run specifications, including environment variables and include file paths, for execution.

methods.name: writeVitestIncludeFile
methods.description: Writes the include patterns to a specified JSON file.

methods.name: buildVitestArgs
methods.description: Produces the final array of Vitest command-line arguments based on the initial arguments.
